stage_a.note: Clear positive engagement characterizes most of the presentation.
Sustained engagement with the subject is evident.
Friendly, approachable orientation with a conversational tone.

venture.description: Wire-free bras for women with large breasts using patented stays technology.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder pitches Behave Bras, explaining the problem of large breasts and introducing her patented wire-free stays technology.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Mark points out that they have the bras in front of them.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Barbara examines the bra.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Lori asks if the part of the bra she is holding is the stay.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder confirms that it is the stay.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Lori asks if it is like an underlining that twists.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder confirms, calling it an obvious non-obvious construction.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Lori notes that the twist forms a pocket.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder adds that it catches each breast.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin asks about the sizing and what the largest size is.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder states they offer sizes 30 to 38, DD to I cup, noting DD is the US average.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Mark expresses shock at the average size.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin asks if I is the largest size.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder clarifies that breasts go all the way up the alphabet to Z.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Lori asks if they really go up to Z.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder confirms yes.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Mark again expresses shock.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: Daymond asks if they usually have a wire and if this is more supportive.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder explains that wire-free is the fastest growing segment in the industry.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin asks why she does not like wire.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder explains that wires feel like a torture device at the end of a long day.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin concludes that they are simply uncomfortable.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Barbara asks if the soft material is a new kind of wire and if it provides the same uplift.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder confirms it provides uplift, mentioning padded straps from customer feedback, and shares her goal to support heavy breasts.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Lori asks what her background is to have figured this out.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder shares her Greek and Italian background and her experience as a brand manager at Procter & Gamble.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Mark asks her to tell them some details about the business.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder details a 2020 launch, $110,000 in sales in 18 months, and high margins on bras and panties.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Mark asks if they only sell direct to consumer.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder confirms they only sell through their website currently.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Barbara asks for the retail price of the bra.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder states the price is 75 dollars.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin asks if she gets a lot of returns.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder says they have a 12 percent return rate, which is lower than the industry average.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Barbara expresses positive surprise at the low return rate.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin asks if the game plan is to blow it up direct to consumer and keep the high margins.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder agrees, noting they own the loyal consumer base in a large white space, building a whole brand.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Lori asks if she has patents on the product.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder says they are patent pending for the entire garment and expect the patent in two weeks.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin states he loves the deal and offers the requested money for a larger equity stake.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Barbara remarks that it was a quick deal for Kevin.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder expresses confidence in Kevin and suggests she is the best spokesperson for the partnership.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin agrees he is the best spokesperson and wants to maintain control.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder agrees they would make a very interesting team.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin agrees and pushes to close the deal.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Barbara interrupts to offer the requested money for a slightly lower equity stake.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Barbara asks what her largest obstacle is right now.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder explains her obstacle is living off savings, having moved back home and buying used items.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Lori asks what she is going to say back to Kevin given the competing offer.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder simply replies that she has heard great things about Kevin.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin jokes that all the great things are true.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin urges her to take his deal, explaining why the partnership would be unique.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder counters Kevin's offer, asking if he would match the lower equity stake.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin refuses the counter.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Kevin defends his valuation, emphasizing his promotional value and shared background, pressing for a decision.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: The founder accepts Kevin's original offer.

decisions.note: Loves the deal and wants to be part of keeping breasts behaved.
Asks if she would consider it.
Accepts Kevin's original offer after he refuses to drop to 17%.

record.notes: The founder pitches a bra for large busts. Kevin offers 20%. Barbara offers 17%. The founder counters Kevin at 17%, he refuses, and she accepts his 20% offer.
